notablePrerequisites: You control fewer than nine lands.
description:
Activate Budoka Gardener by tapping it, putting Arid Archway from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Arid Archway enters the battlefield, it and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Resolve the Arid Archway trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Budoka Gardener.
Repeat.

uses.name: Budoka Gardener // Dokai, Weaver of Life
